insights.text: The 6-second bumper was the best-performing asset, with an impressive CTR of 0.94% and a strong completion rate.
Short-form video generated a 0.94% CTR against 0.52% for the 30-second film because consumers have shorter attention spans and prefer snackable content.
The bumper's CTR of 0.94% was almost double the film's 0.52%, and this underscores the need for a short-first creative strategy moving forward, delivering 25% more value per pound.
The film's completion rate of 31% trailed the bumper's 56%, while its cost per completed view was four times higher; long-form video is therefore an expensive way to buy attention.
